evidence.title: Memphis City Council devolves into chaos after data center moratorium vote postponed

occurrences.checkable_against: Memphis City Council meeting recording and October 6, 2026 meeting records
occurrences.quote_span: A Memphis City Council meeting descended into chaos Tuesday night after lawmakers postponed a vote on a proposed yearlong moratorium on new data centers, as protesters chanted inside City Hall, police cleared the chamber and a fight broke out in the lobby.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Memphis City Council

occurrences.checkable_against: Memphis Mayor Paul Young's public statements and Memphis city policy records
occurrences.quote_span: Memphis Mayor Paul Young has called for more rules governing data centers while also pointing to the tax revenue they generate.
occurrences.speaker: Paul Young
occurrences.subject: Memphis City Council

occurrences.checkable_against: Memphis City Council roll-call vote and meeting minutes for October 6, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: The council voted 7-5 to delay the moratorium vote until Oct. 20.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Memphis City Council

occurrences.checkable_against: Action News 5 interview or recording of J.B. Smiley Jr.'s October 6, 2026 remarks
occurrences.quote_span: "When the community shows up, we just have to listen to them," he said, according to Action News 5. "I’m disappointed that we didn’t listen with ears, okay, I hear you, I understand. Let’s figure out how we can do what you want, but also what we believe would be in the best interest of the community."
occurrences.speaker: J.B. Smiley Jr.
occurrences.subject: Memphis City Council

occurrences.checkable_against: Memphis City Council meeting video and transcript for October 6, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: Councilwoman Yolanda Cooper-Sutton exchanged words with protesters before turning her criticism toward Councilman J.B. Smiley Jr., the lead sponsor of the moratorium proposal, according to the outlet.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Memphis City Council

occurrences.checkable_against: Memphis Police Department incident records and lobby video from October 6, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: A fight between two women also broke out in the lobby, with video showing punches being thrown, according to Action News 5.
occurrences.speaker: Action News 5
occurrences.subject: Memphis City Council

occurrences.checkable_against: WREG interview or recording of Jeff Warren's October 6, 2026 remarks
occurrences.quote_span: "If we pass a moratorium, there’s no reason for them to think they need to come here," Warren said, according to WREG. "They get the same benefit from going to DeSoto County, Crittenden County, Fayette County, Tipton County."
occurrences.speaker: Jeff Warren
occurrences.subject: Memphis City Council

occurrences.checkable_against: Memphis City Council agenda and meeting minutes for October 6, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: delay the moratorium vote until Oct. 20.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Memphis City Council

occurrences.checkable_against: Memphis City Council roll-call vote and attendance record for October 6, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: Seven council members voted to postpone the measure, while five opposed the delay. Councilman Edmund Ford Sr. was absent, according to Action News 5.
occurrences.speaker: Action News 5
occurrences.subject: Memphis City Council

occurrences.checkable_against: J.B. Smiley Jr.'s October 6, 2026 remarks and council meeting transcript
occurrences.quote_span: Smiley said council members should have done more to listen to residents who attended the meeting.
occurrences.speaker: J.B. Smiley Jr.
occurrences.subject: Memphis City Council

occurrences.checkable_against: Recording or transcript of Yolanda Cooper-Sutton's October 6, 2026 council remarks
occurrences.quote_span: "That’s all he does; he brings up mess," Cooper-Sutton said of Smiley. "That’s all you do, J.B. Smiley, confuse the people over, over, over and over!"
occurrences.speaker: Yolanda Cooper-Sutton
occurrences.subject: Memphis City Council

occurrences.checkable_against: Memphis City Council meeting video and transcript for October 6, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: Council members also clashed during the meeting.

occurrences.subject: Memphis City Council

occurrences.checkable_against: Jeff Warren's October 6, 2026 council remarks and Memphis Council meeting transcript
occurrences.quote_span: Councilman Jeff Warren, who opposes the moratorium, warned that a year-long pause could push companies to build outside Memphis.

occurrences.checkable_against: Proposed Memphis data center moratorium ordinance
occurrences.quote_span: The proposed ordinance would pause new data center projects for 12 months while the city studies their effects on health and Memphis' power, water and other infrastructure.

occurrences.subject: Memphis City Council

occurrences.checkable_against: Memphis City Council agenda, meeting transcript and recording for October 6, 2026

occurrences.checkable_against: Memphis City Hall security video and meeting recording from October 6, 2026
occurrences.quote_span: After the vote was postponed, protesters chanted, "This is our city," and, "Show me what democracy looks like," as police moved to clear people from the chamber.

occurrences.checkable_against: WREG interview with Memphis Mayor Paul Young
occurrences.quote_span: "We need to keep the pressure high and make sure that we get the guardrails in place that we need for our community to feel protected," Young told WREG.
